ledger_contract.note: Real calls and UTC timestamps; native RF records may be indexed instead of duplicated. No per-step human signoff.

steps.label: Nine-dimension coverage
steps.research: Foundation/growth/industry/competition/capacity/technology/policy/customer/demand: used parameter links, material gaps or reasoned immateriality; not nine reports or nine numerical growth add-ons.

steps.label: Freeze information set
steps.research: Resolve identity once; Oct8 information cutoff with actual later retrieval/read/verification UTC. Future publication refused; unknown availability needs reliable exact-SHA proof or gap.

steps.label: Management communication and targets
steps.entry: RF/FF/CWP source preparation; research.communication_scope; research.input_targets; research.target_measurement
steps.research: Latest six communication categories, bounded actual search and original reads; exact wording/annual versus run-rate/cumulative/ambiguous; modeled treatment or all-scenario independent benchmark; explicit gaps.

steps.label: Independent reference case
steps.research: Comparable source/period/scope/unit/ranges, conversion assumptions and contrary evidence; independent benchmark before adopting management's target. Missing magnitude stays unverified/conditional.

steps.label: History and base
steps.entry: native historical/base validation and formal engine
steps.research: At least two primary historical company observations unless explicitly pre-revenue; reported revenue = segment external revenue + signed base adjustments. Stop if units/perimeter/base do not reconcile.

steps.label: Sources and parameters
steps.research: Genuine public capture records, exact locator/excerpt/hash/check date; reported/management/third-party/assumption semantics; real span→claim→used parameter→formula dependency; directional evidence never becomes numerical range.

steps.label: Revenue curves
steps.research: Distinct streams/lifecycle/cohorts and material read items; parent inclusion/cannibalization/shared bottlenecks; native registered model and required drivers; do not invent finer inputs.

steps.label: Recognized revenue
steps.research: Point/over time, trigger, gross/net, policy claim, progress/lag/carry-in. Orders/backlog/TAM/shipments are not automatically recognized revenue.

steps.label: Driver scenarios
steps.entry: native formula DAG; research.timing_bridge when supported
steps.research: Source/range/scope/period→transparent conversions→Low/Base/High; same segment model, joint economics and bounded constraints; explicit delays/cancellations only with genuine support. No silent annual sorting.

steps.label: Causal revenue-driver tree
steps.entry: native growth-driver validation and formal computed allocations
steps.research: Base used IDs, two-to-eight-step mechanism, horizon/persistence, leading indicators/falsifiers/counterevidence; weights sum one; rank computed terminal increment and disclose analyst allocation/headwinds.

steps.label: Aggregate and bridge
steps.research: Recognition→effective segment revenue→company with signed adjustments once; reconcile each year; aggregate-company CAGR, not average segment CAGR.

steps.label: Sensitivity and theme increments
steps.entry: engine calls analysis.sensitivity.calculate_sensitivities; research.input_quantities.convert_input_quantity; native theme recipe when applicable
steps.research: Actual used Base assumptions/stresses once, percent/pp/bp/absolute/range/discrete, requested/effective/clamp/dependencies; joint stresses separately consistent, not sum of single effects.

steps.label: Confidence
steps.entry: formal engine confidence calculation and eligible historical accuracy records
steps.research: Revenue-weighted verified evidence/freshness/model coverage/eligible frozen accuracy/sensitivity; disclose economic/sample limitations. Confidence is not Base probability or growth magnitude.

steps.label: Validation and delivery
steps.research: Same native result supplies JSON/Markdown, actual failures retained; source/parameter/recognition/scenario/bridge/CAGR/publication gates; no hand-edited numerical result.

steps.label: Freeze and backtest
steps.entry: revenue_backtest.py create/evaluate; publication_registry.py lookup/audit; audit_run.py check
steps.research: Immutable create with matching forecast_version and exclusive registry file; actual future results absent means backtest not_run/N/A. Seal execution before independent review; integrity checks are not research PASS.
